internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service High Error Rate Resolved
internal.body:
At 10:14 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for the cart service due to a 100% error rate caused by a dependency being unreachable. The diagnosis confirmed that the cart service's dependency was unreachable, leading to the service errors. A flag was set to disable the cartFailure flag, which was approved and executed by the on-call team. Recovery was verified shortly after, with error rates returning to normal levels by 10:34 UTC.

No other services were found to be the root cause, although elevated error rates were observed in checkout and frontend services. The incident was resolved by addressing the cart service dependency issue.

Timeline:
- 10:14 UTC: Alert received for cart service error rate spike.
- 10:34 UTC: Diagnosis confirmed dependency unreachable.
- 10:34 UTC: Flag to disable cartFailure set and approved.
- 10:34 UTC: Recovery verified with normalized error rates.

Next steps include reviewing dependency monitoring and improving alerting to detect such issues earlier.
